slot_policy: case-insensitive lexical rank within each story's configured character and location values; generator list order and split-global vocabulary are not used as labels

classification_policy.robust: Both test and generalization_holdout are strong.
classification_policy.weak: Either held-out split has weak or strong signal, unless a relative-improvement label applies.
classification_policy.relative: Every test/generalization macro-F1 delta versus the applicable prior baseline(s) must be positive, with at least one gain >= 0.05.
